create_new_chat_session: create a new chat session with a timestamp-based unique identifier and reset messages
switch_to_chat_session: switch the active chat context to a different session by session_id and load its message history
get_llm_response: generate and stream an LLM response with optional reasoning process display using placeholders
run_vllm_chatbot: run the vLLM Streamlit chatbot webserver with configurable API endpoint via environment variables
check_server_reasoning: check if the connected vLLM model supports reasoning capability and toggle reasoning display
